sql:
SELECT track_versions.id, track_versions.track_id, track_versions.number, track_versions.name, track_versions.content_hash, track_versions.revision_key, track_versions.manifest, track_versions.discovery, track_versions.state, track_versions.created_at, track_versions.published_at, track_versions.creator_test_run_id, track_versions.rating_sum, track_versions.rating_count 
FROM track_versions JOIN tracks ON tracks.id = track_versions.track_id JOIN players ON players.id = tracks.owner_id JOIN (SELECT track_versions.track_id AS track, max(track_versions.number) AS number 
FROM track_versions 
WHERE track_versions.state = ? GROUP BY track_versions.track_id) AS anon_1 ON anon_1.track = tracks.id AND anon_1.number = track_versions.number LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT boards.version_id AS version, count(distinct(personal_bests.player_id)) AS drivers 
FROM boards JOIN personal_bests ON personal_bests.board_id = boards.id JOIN players ON players.id = personal_bests.player_id 
WHERE players.disabled IS 0 AND players.is_test_driver IS 0 AND JSON_EXTRACT(boards.manifest, ?) IS NULL AND JSON_EXTRACT(boards.manifest, ?) IS NOT 1 GROUP BY boards.version_id) AS anon_2 ON anon_2.version = track_versions.id 
WHERE track_versions.state = ? AND tracks.hidden IS 0 AND players.disabled IS 0 AND (tracks.official IS 1 OR track_versions.rating_count > ? AND track_versions.rating_sum > ? * track_versions.rating_count AND anon_2.drivers > ?) ORDER BY random()
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
